# Fix: Codecov Base Upload workflow 404

## Context
The "Codecov Base Upload" workflow (`codecov-base.yml`) fails every time it runs on push to `main`. The step "Download coverage from latest CI run" gets a 404 from the GitHub API. This means Codecov never gets base branch coverage, so PR coverage diffs don't work.

## Root Cause
In `.github/workflows/codecov-base.yml` line 27-29, the `gh api` call uses `-f per_page=5`. The `-f` flag causes `gh api` to switch from GET to POST. The GitHub API endpoint (`/actions/workflows/{id}/runs`) only accepts GET, returning 404 for POST.

## Fix
**File:** `.github/workflows/codecov-base.yml`

Change line 27-29 from:
```bash
RUN_ID=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs \
  --jq '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.conclusion == "success")][0].id' \
  -f per_page=5)
```
To:
```bash
RUN_ID=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?per_page=5" \
  --jq '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.conclusion == "success")][0].id')
```

No other `gh api` calls in the file use `-f`, so this is the only line that needs changing.

## Verification
- Push the fix to a branch, merge to `main`, and confirm the Codecov Base Upload workflow passes
- Or: manually run the corrected `gh api` command to confirm it returns a valid run ID (already verified locally)

name: Codecov Base Upload

# Upload coverage to Codecov for the main branch so PR diffs work.
# The full CI only runs on pull_request — this lightweight job
# downloads the cached coverage artifact and re-uploads it tagged
# to the main branch commit.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  actions: read

jobs:
  upload-coverage:
    name: Upload base coverage to Codecov
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download coverage from latest CI run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Find the most recent successful CI workflow run
          RUN_ID=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs \
            --jq '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.conclusion == "success")][0].id' \
            -f per_page=5)

          if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ] || [ "$RUN_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "No successful CI run found, skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Using CI run: $RUN_ID"

          # Find the coverage artifact
          ARTIFACT_ID=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/artifacts \
            --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.name == "coverage-lcov") | .id')

          if [ -z "$ARTIFACT_ID" ] || [ "$ARTIFACT_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "No coverage artifact found, skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Downloading artifact: $ARTIFACT_ID"

          # Download and extract
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts/$ARTIFACT_ID/zip > coverage.zip
          unzip -o coverage.zip

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: hashFiles('**/lcov.info') != ''
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false
